verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only scattered tier-gating notes in developer docs: MCP design resizing is limited to "Canva Pro and above", and private Connect integrations require a Canva Enterprise plan. That shows some tiers and feature gating exist, but nothing shows a published pricing page that lays out prices, seat types or AI-feature gating before procurement. Missing for 10: published plan pricing/prices, seat-type definitions, a full tier comparison, explicit AI-feature gating per plan, independent corroboration.
